output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and totalSupply variables are set to 2000000000000000000000000000, which is a large number, and mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target] without overflow checking, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary tokens to any user's account.

The mintToken function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target] and totalSupply, and also transferred to target, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary tokens to any user's account.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _transfer function is called, where balanceOf[_from] is checked to be greater than or equal to _value, and balanceOf[_to] + _value is checked to be greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing a user to cause an integer overflow in the balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value operations, if _value is large enough, resulting in a locked funds.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] and from balanceOf[_from], allowing a user to cause an integer overflow in the balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value operations, if _value is large enough, resulting in a locked funds.

The burnFrom function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] and from allowance[_from][msg.sender], allowing an attacker to burn arbitrary tokens from any user's account.
